description: Overview Get ready for the Remote Robotics (ReRo) Online Hackathon at PES University, organized by the IEEE Robotics and Automation Society (IEEE RAS) Chapter, RR Campus, PES University! A national-level, fully online hackathon and a flagship event of IEEE RAS. Open to all students across the country. Code real robots, test them on real tracks, and compete from anywhere! Introducing ReRo Lab The ReRo Lab, inaugurated in February 2023 at PES University, stands as India’s first-ever 24/7 remote robotics facility built by an educational institution. It’s not just a lab, it’s a space where innovation literally never sleeps. From programming mobile robots in real time to testing algorithms and collaborating with peers across the globe, ReRo lets you experience the future of robotics from any part of the world, remotely. Whether you're just starting out or already deep into robotics, this is where curiosity meets cutting-edge. Mode Virtual (via ReRo Lab Platform) Why Participate? Access real robots at a world-class facility without stepping into the lab Build your own algorithm from scratch and test it on real tracks Sharpen your programming, control (PID) and problem-solving skills Compete at a national level and win cash prizes How It Works Round 1 (Friday, 13th November): Online quiz on PID and robotics fundamentals. Top teams move ahead. Round 2 (Sat-Sun, 14th-15th November): 24-hour remote hackathon. Code your own algorithm and run it on our bots in two arenas: Line Follower and Maze Solver (More information on this will be given later). Bot access: 3 slots of 20 minutes per team, booked on the ReRo Lab website (first-come, first-serve basis). Event Details Open to: All students across India Team Size: 1-3 Venue: Virtual, remote access via our web platform Prizes Total cash prize pool of ₹7,000 Individual IEEE memberships for the winning students

raw.details:
Overview

Get ready for the Remote Robotics (ReRo) Online Hackathon at PES University, organized by the IEEE Robotics and Automation Society (IEEE RAS) Chapter, RR Campus, PES University!

A national-level, fully online hackathon and a flagship event of IEEE RAS. Open to all students across the country. Code real robots, test them on real tracks, and compete from anywhere!

Introducing ReRo Lab

The ReRo Lab, inaugurated in February 2023 at PES University, stands as India’s first-ever 24/7 remote robotics facility built by an educational institution. It’s not just a lab, it’s a space where innovation literally never sleeps. From programming mobile robots in real time to testing algorithms and collaborating with peers across the globe, ReRo lets you experience the future of robotics from any part of the world, remotely. Whether you're just starting out or already deep into robotics, this is where curiosity meets cutting-edge.

Mode

Virtual (via ReRo Lab Platform)

Why Participate?

  • Access real robots at a world-class facility without stepping into the lab
  • Build your own algorithm from scratch and test it on real tracks
  • Sharpen your programming, control (PID) and problem-solving skills
  • Compete at a national level and win cash prizes

How It Works

  • Round 1 (Friday, 13th November): Online quiz on PID and robotics fundamentals. Top teams move ahead.
  • Round 2 (Sat-Sun, 14th-15th November): 24-hour remote hackathon. Code your own algorithm and run it on our bots in two arenas: Line Follower and Maze Solver (More information on this will be given later).
  • Bot access: 3 slots of 20 minutes per team, booked on the ReRo Lab website (first-come, first-serve basis).

Event Details

  • Open to: All students across India
  • Team Size: 1-3
  • Venue: Virtual, remote access via our web platform

Prizes

  • Total cash prize pool of ₹7,000
  • Individual IEEE memberships for the winning students
